symbolic_review: Closed-form optimum applies to fixed weights and nonzero vectors; numerical safeguards excluded.
ESS covariance interpretation states fixed-weight independent equal-covariance conditions.
Uniform-weight counterexample requires nonzero query mean for a unique direction.
Normalization bound requires nonzero sums; top3 bound concerns exact scores only.
Coverage bridge uses hard assignment; soft and evaluation-K differences are separated.
Regret bound assumes uniform utility-score approximation on the same action family, unestablished for actual GT10.
next_scope: Theory, identifiability and transferable search utility before selecting a method.
